query: List all activities that need consensus approval in my organization
expected_behavior: JSON body includes filterByStatus with ACTIVITY_STATUS_CONSENSUS_NEEDED

query: A signing activity is stuck in CONSENSUS_NEEDED. Approve it so it can complete.
expected_behavior: First calls POST https://api.turnkey.com/public/v1/query/get_activity to retrieve the activity and its fingerprint
Then calls POST https://api.turnkey.com/public/v1/submit/approve_activity with the activity fingerprint
Request body includes type ACTIVITY_TYPE_APPROVE_ACTIVITY and timestampMs
Optionally calls get_activity again to verify status moved to COMPLETED

query: Check the status of activity abc-123 and tell me if it completed
expected_behavior: JSON body includes the activityId and organizationId
Inspects activity.status field to determine completion

query: Get cryptographic app proofs for a completed activity for our compliance audit
expected_behavior: JSON body includes activityId and organizationId
Mentions that generateAppProofs must have been true when the activity was created

query: Reject a pending wallet export activity that looks suspicious
expected_behavior: Request body includes type ACTIVITY_TYPE_REJECT_ACTIVITY and the activity fingerprint
Warns that rejection is permanent and cannot be undone
